title: Priority classifier & action matrix for hosted API enterprise requests
creator: Ava Morales
description: Problem: Enterprise customers submit hosted API feature requests that span chat, streaming, tool/function-calls, and structured outputs. Our current intake is inconsistent: some requests go directly to engineering, others sit in a shared backlog with no enterprise-specific signals applied. Outcome: we need a deterministic classifier + action matrix that converts inbound request signals into a recommended route (Backlog, Planned, Fast-track + Solutions, Dedicated scoping, Security review, Immediate escalation) and a clear handoff checklist for engineering/solutions/sales/CS.
goals: 1) Reduce time-to-first-action for enterprise requests from >10 business days to <=3 business days for 'High' and 'Escalate' buckets. 2) Ensure consistency in routing decisions and provide transparent justification in ticket comments. 3) Enable automatic metrics (avg decision time, percent routed to dedicated scopes, downstream engineering cost estimate) for prioritization reviews.
intake_signals_and_weights:
Signals we will extract from inbound requests (weighted):
- Customer tier (Enterprise / Midmarket / Startup): weight 30
- Expected QPS / latency requirement: weight 15
- Data residency / compliance requirement: weight 15
- Feature category (chat / streaming / tool-calls / structured outputs): weight 10
- Security / PII exposure flagged: weight 15
- Revenue/ARR influence or prospect stage: weight 10
Thresholds: score >= 75 => Escalate (fast-track + dedicated scoping); 50-74 => High (planned in next cycle + SOW estimate); 25-49 => Medium (Backlog, request clarifications); <25 => Low (monitor, deny or deflect).
routing_action_matrix:
Actions and required recipients: 
- Escalate: notify Enterprise PM, Solutions Eng, Security, and Sales; create dedicated RFC with 3-day SLA for initial scoping.
- High: create PM spec ticket with estimate, assign Eng triage owner, add to next planning cycle queue.
- Medium: request clarifying questionnaire to requestor (auto-email template), hold in curated backlog, monitor usage signals.
- Low: provide self-serve guidance (docs snippet or examples), close with feedback loop.
- Dedicated scoping required: open Dedicated Intake form, trigger infra capacity check with InfraOps.
- Security review required: create security_review ticket and block engineering until completion.
Each routed ticket must include: signal summary, computed score, routing justification (one sentence), required stakeholders, suggested SLA and next steps.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Classifier implemented as a gating step in intake form with visible score and routing recommendation. 2) Every enterprise request ticket created after gating contains the signal summary and computed score in the first comment. 3) PM/Eng/Solutions can override recommendation with documented reason; overrides must be captured as a structured comment. 4) Dashboards track decision latency and % routed by bucket. 5) Pilot routing behavior matches manual triage for 8/10 sampled historical enterprise requests.
metrics_to_track:
- Decision latency (hours) for high/escalate buckets
- % enterprise requests routed to Dedicated scoping
- Avg engineering estimate (person-days) for routed items
- Override rate (manual vs classifier)
- Time from routing to first engagement by Solutions/Eng
- Customer satisfaction (CS follow-up NPS) after scoping
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: Over-weighting revenue results in noisy Escalations. Mitigation: cap revenue contribution to max 30 points and require a second signal (security or latency) for auto-escalate.
Risk: Classifier gamed by inaccurate request inputs. Mitigation: require verification fields for high-impact signals and Solutions Eng validation step for Escalate.
Risk: Bottleneck at Solutions Eng. Mitigation: create 48-hour response SLA and rotate on-call Solutions Eng pairing.
implementation_notes: Phase 1 (2 sprints): build intake gating UI + classifier backend (simple rules + weights), wire into Linear creation template, add automatic comment with score. Phase 2 (3 sprints): add override UI, dashboards, routing webhooks to PagerDuty/Slack, and Dedicated intake integration. Phase 3: iterate ML-backed classifier after collecting 500 labeled decisions.
next_steps: 1) Align stakeholders and finalize weights (workshop 2026-03-12). 2) Design intake gating UI (task DES-221). 3) Engineering spike on classifier prototype and webhook integration (task ENG-1829). 4) Build initial Linear template and webhook mapping. 5) Pilot with 3 strategic enterprise customers for 6 weeks.
